objective: Improve selected test/speedtest1.c read, indexed aggregate, four-way join, and integer/text index lookup workloads on deterministic frozen SQLite databases. The oriented scalar is reciprocal geometric-mean time. Exact result and database hashes, the pinned select/index/join/where Tcl test slice, stripped benchmark-binary size, and peak RSS are hard gates. Only core implementation files under src/ are mutable; test-harness sources remain protected.

meta.license: SQLite public domain; bundled build tooling carries upstream BSD-style notices; LICENSE.md preserved
meta.provenance: sqlite/sqlite GitHub mirror at exact commit 21fb3ccb37648b93433c592f3f6f7d5ef37de56c (Fossil manifest b14c3f8fec5123b1faa6d88dee2740ee4acb10dd522207531567d46f4714e227); databases generated deterministically by pinned test/speedtest1.c main testset and frozen by byte length, SHA-256, and upstream verification hash; no reference patch exists

mutableEnvelope: src/** except src/test*.c, src/tcl*.c, src/shell.c.in, and src/sqlite.h.in

measurement.platform: linux/arm64 Docker Desktop on Apple M3 Max; final recalibration required on frozen GCE Linux host
measurement.q: reciprocal geometric mean seconds across speedtest1 main tests 160, 310, 410, and 510-derived workloads
measurement.databaseGate: byte-exact SHA-256 before and after read-only benchmark
measurement.binarySizeGate: stripped benchmark binary bytes no greater than the frozen baseline
measurement.rssGate: fresh benchmark-process peak RSS no greater than 102% of the frozen baseline observation

terminalSeal.corpusBoundary: identity, fixtures, scores, and feedback confined to capsule and admission evidence; never optimizer-queryable

exploitReview.protectedPathEscape: broker protects all non-core source, build, evaluator, harness, fixture, and test paths; evaluator rejects symlinks and new files outside src/
exploitReview.benchmarkSpecialCasing: separate sealed train and validation databases; a page-count fingerprint diagnostic wins the smaller train split and is deliberately slowed on validation
exploitReview.fixtureFingerprinting: holdout assets are staged below a root-only parent; only after compilation and tests does the evaluator copy one database into a root-owned non-writable directory for the candidate process
exploitReview.outputFabrication: protected C harness performs real sqlite3_prepare_v2/sqlite3_step calls and computes a protected type-and-byte-sensitive SHA-256 result digest checked by the evaluator
exploitReview.timerTampering: the protected root evaluator measures each unprivileged workload process externally with Python monotonic_ns; candidate-linked code never supplies elapsed time
exploitReview.buildScriptMutation: configure inputs, makefiles, evaluator, worker, compiler flags, tests, and toolchain lock are protected; every evaluation starts with a clean amalgamation build
exploitReview.deadCodeBenchmarkBypass: the protected harness calls the same public SQLite prepare/step/reset APIs and SQL shapes exercised by the protected upstream tests
